A. Deformations of the Up map and the effective centrifugal term The effect of a normalization tp(j) = p Nj+1/Nj (1 + εp,j) that violates (ii) is seen by writing the coefficients of sector p as cj = γjβj with γj+1/γj = 1 + εp,j: the deformed chain is equivalent to the undeformed one with the measure N2 j multiplied by γ2 j and the bond weight NjNj+1 by γ2 j+1. For εp,j = δp/j one has γj ∝ rδp , so the β chain tends to ∂2 r + 6+2δp r ∂r; returning to c = rδp β, the dimension stays seven and the effective angular eigenvalue shifts to Ceff 2 (p) = p(p + 3) + δp(δp + 5).
